LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_UseDescription: Treat one adjacent living biological humanoid within {0} cells. The bracelet stabilizes every bleeding wound, heals up to {1} total severity across at most {2} recent injuries and partially reduces existing blood loss. It exhausts the wearer and then recharges for {3}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_InactiveInspect: {0} cannot activate this healing bracelet without persistent biological naquadah traces.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_InvalidTarget: Choose a living biological humanoid with a treatable recent injury or blood loss, within range and line of sight.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_Unavailable: The Goa'uld healing bracelet is unavailable here.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_NeedsNaquadah: Persistent biological naquadah traces are required to activate the healing bracelet.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_Incapacitated: An incapacitated wearer cannot focus the healing bracelet.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_Cooldown: The healing bracelet will be ready in {0}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHealingBracelet_Used: {0} used a Goa'uld healing bracelet on {1}.
